title: Scam/Subversive methods to obtain download
body:
I just downloaded your app specifically because via AppAdvice it said there was a free lifetime pro version in the settings.

There is NO ‘Get Pro’ button anywhere in the settings. 

For shame! 

Also your app description says “no data collected” but the privacy link I read from the app says you do!

This is notice to:
Remove all my data, including my name, this email, any other email you have on file, any device Id or other ID or phone number as a result of me downloading this app and using it.

title: Very deceptive.
body:
When setting up, the only option is to start a three-day trial, after which you’ll be billed $24.99 a year. 
There is no free version, as we’re led to believe. 
There is no $3.99 version, as we’re led to believe.
All very different as presented in the app store.
Glad I deleted it. Could be a nice app. I’ll never know, and I’m perfectly fine with that.
